name: Lyo.Cache
tagline: Local `ICacheService` plus typed byte payload methods. Serialize once, store framed bytes, optionally compress or encrypt on .NET 10+.
description: Local `ICacheService` plus typed byte payload methods. Serialize values once, store framed bytes (optional compression / encryption on .NET 10+), and round-trip without Fusion's default CLR binary formatter. Fusion-backed `ICacheService` lives in `Lyo.Cache.Fusion`.
features: **`AddLocalCache` / `AddLocalCacheFromConfiguration`.** In-process cache backed by `IMemoryCache`. Wires `ICachePayloadCodec`, `ICachePayloadSerializer`, and the payload-aware `ICacheService` (singleton `LocalCacheService`). The serializer is registered with `TryAddSingleton` so hosts can pre-register their own `ICachePayloadSerializer`, for example one bound to the host's `JsonOptions`, before calling `AddLocalCache*`.
**`AddFusionCache` (in `Lyo.Cache.Fusion`).** Same payload services. `FusionCacheService` implements the byte and typed `GetOrSetPayloadAsync` / `GetOrSetPayloadAsync<T>` overloads.

sections.title: Registration
items: **`AddLocalCache` / `AddLocalCacheFromConfiguration`.** In-process cache backed by `IMemoryCache`. Wires `ICachePayloadCodec`, `ICachePayloadSerializer`, and the payload-aware `ICacheService` (singleton `LocalCacheService`). The serializer is registered with `TryAddSingleton` so hosts can pre-register their own `ICachePayloadSerializer`, for example one bound to the host's `JsonOptions`, before calling `AddLocalCache*`.
**`AddFusionCache` (in `Lyo.Cache.Fusion`).** Same payload services. `FusionCacheService` implements the byte and typed `GetOrSetPayloadAsync` / `GetOrSetPayloadAsync<T>` overloads.

sections.title: Expiration
sections.lead: Entries have a duration and an expiration mode. Writes stamp the policy; reads honor it. Existing TimeSpan duration overloads are Absolute. Sliding is opt-in via setupAction (`SetSlidingExpiration`). Local uses IMemoryCache sliding; Fusion re-Sets on hit. Callers use only ICacheService.
rows: Expire Duration after write. Successful reads do not extend lifetime.
Expire Duration after the last successful access. TryGetValue / GetOrSet / payload hits reset the clock.

sections.title: Bypass behavior
sections.text: When `CacheOptions.Enabled` is `false`, `LocalCacheService` skips storage. Factories run on every call. `Set` / `SetPayload` are no-ops. `TryGetValue` / `TryGetPayload` return false. Invalidation calls return immediately. Use this for tests, local diagnostics, and dynamic cache-off toggles.

sections.title: L1 item snapshot
sections.text: `ICacheService.Items` is this process's in-memory (L1) key and tag list, not a Redis dump. `CacheItem.Encrypted`, `Compressed`, and `SizeBytes` come from framed payload entries this process has written or decoded on a payload hit. Object `Set` / `GetOrSet` keys report encrypted/compressed as false and leave size unset. Keys also carry `Expires` (UTC instant from the entry TTL; sliding hits push it forward). Tags leave storage flags and `Expires` null. Other processes can write L2 keys that never appear here. There is no background L2 sync.

sections.title: Reflection / metadata TTLs
rows: Reflected `PropertyInfo` lookups, for example query comparison helpers.
Type metadata used by conversion and comparison.
sections.lead: `CacheOptions` exposes dedicated lifetimes used by reflection-heavy helpers in other Lyo packages so they can share a single cache instance:

sections.title: Invalidation methods
rows: Removes a single entry (key is normalized lower-invariant) and drops its tag index entries.
Removes entries tagged for a CLR type name (typical tag shape `type:<full name>`).
Invalidates cached queries tagged for entity type `TDb` (typically `entity:<name>`).
Drops all entries tagged for general list/query caching (implementation-defined `queries` tag).
sections.lead: `ICacheService` extends `IHealth` and exposes these invalidation methods used by Lyo.Api and downstream CRUD plumbing.
sections.trail:
`MaxBulkQueryInvalidationByIdCount` (default `20`) controls when CRUD invalidation helpers in Lyo.Api fall back from per-PK tags to a single type-wide
`entity:<type>` tag during bulk mutations. It is ignored when `QueryCacheTagGranularity` is `Broad` (which is always type-wide anyway).

sections.title: Health
sections.text: Both `ICacheService` implementations (`LocalCacheService` and Fusion's `FusionCacheService`) implement `IHealth` with `HealthCheckName = "cache"`. The probe round-trips a short-lived test key tagged `lyo-health-check` and reports timing through `HealthResult.Healthy` / `HealthResult.Unhealthy`. Registering the cache adds this probe to hosts that resolve `IEnumerable<IHealth>`.

sections.title: Query cache tag granularity (`QueryCacheTagGranularity`)
rows: Type-scoped tags (`entity:{typename}`, scope/shape tags). Lower CPU when attaching tags on cache write. Any mutation to that entity type clears all cached queries/GETs for the type.
Adds per-primary-key instance tags (`entity:{type}:{pk}`) so invalidation can target only affected pages. Higher tagging cost, finer busting.
sections.lead: Used by `Lyo.Api` when tagging `POST …/QueryConcrete`, `POST …/QueryProject`, and `GET` cache entries for Fusion `RemoveByTagAsync` invalidation.
sections.trail: Set in configuration as `"QueryCacheTagGranularity": "Broad"` or `"Granular"`. See `QueryCacheTagBuilder` and `QueryCacheInvalidation` in `Lyo.Api`.

sections.title: Payload pipeline (`CacheOptions.Payload`)
rows: Object to UTF-8 bytes (default: `SystemTextJsonCachePayloadSerializer`). Hosts can replace the registration so serialization matches HTTP JSON options.
Frames plaintext bytes. Optional `AutoCompress` above `AutoCompressMinSizeBytes`. Optional `AutoEncrypt` (net10, requires `IEncryptionService`). See `CachePayloadCodec`.
sections.lead: Used when callers use `ICacheService.GetOrSetPayloadAsync` / `GetOrSetPayloadAsync<T>`, for example `QueryOptions.CacheQueryResultsAsUtf8Payload` in Lyo.Api.

sections.title: API hosts (Lyo.Api)
sections.text: `AddLyoQueryServices` registers `ICachePayloadSerializer` to use the host's `JsonOptions`, falling back to shared defaults. Cached query payloads stay aligned with REST JSON for `QueryConcreteReq` / `ProjectionQueryReq` shapes. See the Lyo.Api README *Query result caching* section for `QueryOptions:CacheQueryResultsAsUtf8Payload` and how `POST …/QueryConcrete` and `POST …/QueryProject` both honor it.
